pr_metadata.title: feat(box): bake the log-search tier into the obs box (additive) — box-fit gate passes (#1178)
pr_metadata.summary: Fold the OpenSearch/Dashboards/Data-Prepper install-half roles into bake-obs.yml so one obs box bakes the whole observability platform (metrics + logs); box-fit gate measured + a full re-bake proves the merged box builds cleanly at 7.12 GiB actual — ~11 GiB under the 18/20 GiB ceiling.
pr_metadata.notes: Epic #267 Task 1. Additive by design (keeps this PR vrg-validate-green); the coordinated removal (retire bake-logsearch.yml + logsearch-ubuntu2404 fleet entry + the logsearch node) moves to #1179 (noted there) so topology<->box<->bake stay consistent in one PR. Box-fit gate (docs/reports/2026-09-24-obs-box-fit-gate.md): obs 5.57 + logsearch 3.29 GiB, merged proven at 7.12 GiB actual vs 18 GiB partition/20 GiB ceiling. Merged-box re-bake succeeded (721s, box added + cached). vrg-validate green. Bootable-services proof rides VAL #1177 (cold-rebuild).
